topic.description: Short label for the decision being made. 2-5 words, lowercase, no trailing period. Examples: 'authentication strategy', 'micro-SaaS ideation', 'weekend trip from London'.

submit_instruction.description: The instruction Claude runs when the user commits a path. One sentence, imperative, naming the artifact to produce. Example: 'Turn this into a one-page idea brief: problem, value, MVP scope, key technical decisions, biggest risk.'

question.description: The L0 question. Short and conversational, ends with '?'. Frames the top-level decision.

basis.description: One sentence explaining why this question is the right starting point for the topic.

branches.description: L0 branches. 2 to 4 entries, each meaningfully different from the others. The L1 question under each branch must be a different question, not the same question with different filters. Same 2-4 range applies at L1 and L2 (set in each branch's 'sub.branches').

id.description: Kebab-case identifier, unique within its parent branches array.

title.description: 3 to 5 words. The branch's own framing, not its parent's.

summary.description: One to two sentences. For L2 leaves, concrete and committable - name the specific pattern, tool, or approach, do not describe abstractly.

next_hint.description: Short phrase describing what the next decision under this branch explores. Set to null for L2 leaves.

sub.description: Nested decision under this branch, same shape as 'tree'. Set to null for L2 leaves. Max tree depth: L0 -> L1 -> L2.
